arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight', flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking',booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',c.charge_id,json_object('booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'booking' kind,b.booking_id id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel',(SELECT group_concat(step) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.status,b.client_reference,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS charges FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IN (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL)

SELECT 'booking' kind,b.booking_id id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel_steps',(SELECT json_group_array(e.step) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config
